verdicts.why: Bloodlines (#59) reveals Mystique as Graydon's mother (Sabretooth appears, and Graydon was already known as his son); in Promise of Apocalypse (#64) Mystique and Sabretooth try to capture Psylocke for Apocalypse.
In The Cure (#9) Gambit follows Rogue and tries to talk her out of the cure, jokingly suggesting a vacation together, which reminds her she cannot touch him; Cody is #45 and the ski trip #53.
Cable's shot unleashing Apocalypse, Rogue's Celestial power freeing Gambit and trapping Apocalypse, and Nightcrawler's sacrifice are all Survival of the Fittest (#19).
Xavier and Emma Frost battle for Jean's mind in The Dark Phoenix Part II (#41), and Xavier calls the Trial of Combat in Part IV (#43).
In Xavier Remembers (#50) the Shadow King possesses the concussed Xavier, and Jean reaches him so that together they re-imprison it in the Astral Plane.
Wolverine is on Xavier's X-Men from Night of the Sentinels (#1); in Enter Magneto (#3) he switches off Sabretooth's life support and objects to Xavier wanting to rehabilitate him.
Whatever It Takes (#16): Xavier and Magneto survive the avalanche, reach the Savage Land and cannot use their powers; Magneto leaves as an enemy in Reunion Part 2 (#26).
To Me, My X-Men (#1) ends with Magneto revealing Xavier's will gave him the X-Men; Xavier takes control of Magneto and later helps repair his mind in Tolerance Is Extinction Part 3 (#10).
Rise of Apocalypse Part 1 (#13): Magneto tries to impart Xavier's philosophy to Nur; Part 2 (#14): Apocalypse kills Magneto in front of Xavier.

The Morph clash is Night of the Sentinels Part II (#2), but the rivalry over Jean starts in Captive Hearts (#5), where Logan tells Jean he is waiting for her too and considers getting rid of Scott, so the Jean stage belongs at #5, not #6.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#2

split.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#5
split.text: Scott and Logan clash again and again over Jean.

verdicts.why: Captive Hearts (#5): Jean tells Logan that Scott is waiting for her, Logan says he is waiting too, and he spares Scott so Jean will not cry.
Night of the Sentinels Part I (#1): Storm, Rogue and Gambit fight the mall Sentinel so Jubilee can escape; the Genosha rescue is Slave Island (#7).
Days of Past Future (#11) ends with Cable, Psylocke and Archangel planning a new team against Apocalypse; it acts as X-Force in A Force to Be Reckoned With (#12).
Come the Apocalypse (#10): at Stonehenge Rogue absorbs part of Archangel's dark side; in Obsession (#35) she feels compelled to help him hunt Apocalypse.
Reunion Part 1 (#25): Ka-Zar rescues Magneto and Xavier, resents Magneto's interference in the Savage Land, but agrees to help.
The duel is Captive Hearts (#5); in Have Yourself a Morlock Little X-Mas (#62) Storm gives Callisto back her title as Morlock leader.
Out of the Past Part 1 (#27): Yuriko, blaming Logan for her father's death, uses the Morlocks as hostages to make him open the vessel; Part 2 (#28) the Spirit Drinker fight and the draw.
Storm Front Part 1 (#69): Arkon brings Storm to save his world and asks her to marry him; in Part 2 (#70) he is revealed as a tyrant. Ally fits #69.
Phoenix Saga Part III (#31): Gladiator takes Lilandra captive and Phoenix rescues her and vanquishes him, then urges guarding the crystal; Phoenix joins with the crystal in Part V (#33).
Beyond Good and Evil Part 1 (#63): the Nasty Boys kidnap Jean after she and Scott remarry, leaving Scott behind; taking both of them was Till Death Do Us Part (#15).

Fire Made Flesh (#3): the newly arrived woman is confirmed as the real Jean, who escaped Sinister, and his clone is exposed; Jean strips Sinister's augmentations in Tolerance Is Extinction Part 3 (#10).
Sanctuary Part 2 (#49) ends with Deathbird and Apocalypse rescuing Cortez, whom Apocalypse sets to recruit for him; Apocalypse takes his body in The Fifth Horseman (#71).
The Cortez rescue with Apocalypse is Sanctuary Part 2 (#49); Deathbird attacking Lilandra with Apocalypse, who abandons her once Oracle is taken, is Promise of Apocalypse (#64).

Rise of Apocalypse Part 1 (#13): Xavier does not trust Nur, who turns on the X-Men when he finds them using Rama-Tut's technology; Part 2 (#14): Nur becomes Apocalypse, stops Xavier leaving and kills Magneto.
Magneto takes Psylocke to the Axis in Promise of Apocalypse (#64); in End and Beginning (#66) he attacks Apocalypse because he feels deceived.
Beyond Good and Evil Part 1 (#63): in 3999 Cable attacks Apocalypse, who steals his time device; Cable lands in the present and joins the X-Men against the Lazarus Chamber in Part 3 (#65).
Apocalypse made Warren a Horseman in #10; in Obsession (#35) Warren, driven mad by serving Apocalypse, has spent his fortune hunting a way to kill him.

Promise of Apocalypse (#64): Mystique and Sabretooth try to capture Psylocke for Apocalypse and Magneto takes her through a portal to the Axis; Bishop frees her and she has him free the others in #66.
Sabretooth is already helping Apocalypse kidnap psychics in Promise of Apocalypse (#64), trying to capture Psylocke with Mystique.
Reunion Part 2 (#26): Xavier removes Sinister's conditioning from Morph, then everyone fires on Sinister and Cyclops's blasts break him apart; Scott does not free Morph himself.
Till Death Do Us Part Part 2 (#15): Wolverine sniffs out Morph, who leads the X-Men to Sinister's hideout, where they fight Sinister and rescue Scott and Jean.
Night of the Sentinels Part II (#2): Sentinels corner the raiding X-Men, then Cyclops brings Wolverine to find the factory, where they destroy the Sentinel stockpile.
Till Death Do Us Part Part 1 (#14): Creed focuses anti-mutant protests on the newly pardoned Beast and tapes the bar riot that the news blames on him.
Till Death Do Us Part Part 2 (#15): Creed puts Jubilee on stage at a Friends of Humanity rally and Wolverine crashes through the ceiling window to save her.
Enter Magneto (#3): the shot Sabretooth is brought to the mansion infirmary and Xavier wants to rehabilitate him; the therapy and his betrayal are Deadly Reunions (#4).

One Man's Worth Part I (#54): Fitzroy, Bantam and Nimrod go to 1959 and Fitzroy's detonator kills Xavier; Part II (#55): Shard stays hurt in 2055 while Bishop, Wolverine and Storm send Nimrod back and save Xavier.
The Phalanx Covenant Part 1 (#67): the Phalanx attack the X-Men and Warlock allies with Beast, Forge and Sinister; the virus is Part 2 (#68).
The Phalanx Covenant Part 1 (#67): the Phalanx attack the X-Men and Warlock allies with Beast, Forge and Sinister; the Phalanx are destroyed in Part 2 (#68).

The #5 start is right, but the split at #7 carried later facts: in Bright Eyes (#7) Cable only stops the Sentinel-converted Trask; the 300-year war warning and the Prime Sentinel attack on Cable, Scott and Jean are Tolerance Is Extinction Part 1 (#8). Split into #7 and #8 stages.

verdicts.why: Rogue traps Apocalypse's consciousness in a crystal and gives it to Cable in Survival of the Fittest (#19).
